name: HabitFlow
description: A polished, dark-themed mobile habit tracker with 7-day history and progress tracking.
prompt: Build me a polished mobile-first habit tracker. Users should be able to create habits, edit habits, delete habits, mark habits complete for today, and view a simple 7-day history for each habit. Show today's completion progress. Persist all data in localStorage. Use a dark modern interface with clear progress indicators and subtle animations. Use only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.
